gaps.roster_source: data/lbprc_2025_rosters.json (2026-27 workbooks plus supplied October transactions)
gaps.sb_2b_3b_split: Synergy sb_from_1b / sb_from_2b is 0 for every advance hitter — runner heuristic did not record steals. LBPRC and 2026 summer files only have total SB/CS.
gaps.sprint_speed: No sprint-speed field in the caches. SPD column is blank.
gaps.pitcher_platoon: No vs-LHB / vs-RHB outcome split (K/GB/WH/BB/OPS) in the pitching cache. Both rows repeat the season line.
gaps.hitter_platoon_k_gb: K% and GB% are season totals. WH is the Synergy whiff vs that hand when swings exist, otherwise the hitter's overall whiff. AVG/OPS use the Synergy split only when that side has at least 15 PA.
gaps.santurce_synergy: WH is Synergy whiffs/swings. Players missing from the opposing advance file, including Santurce, use data/card_whiff.json (2026 summer, then LBPRC, then 2025 summer). A player with no swings in that window stays blank.
gaps.sju_in_br_file: pregame_baserunning_bunting.json omits SJU; SJU counting stats come from lbprc_2025_hitting.json.
